description:
🌌 Dynamic Asteroids
Breathes kinetic life into static asteroid belts & deep space combat!

Game Version: Starsector 0.98.5a (Supports 0.98a-RC8) | Compatibility: Java 8 (Vanilla & Custom JREs)
Required Dependency: LunaLib | Mod Author & Contact (Discord): keltuze

📦 DOWNLOADS (v2.0.75 Latest Release)

📥 Download Standard Edition (EN) [v2.0.75]
📥 Скачать русскую версию (RU) [v2.0.75]

🔗 GitHub Repository & Releases | 💾 100% safe to add or remove mid-campaign.

🚀 What's New in v2.0.75 (Compared to v2.0.70)

• 🛡� Serious Point Defense (x8 Damage to Rocks):
- Before: Point defense struggled against dense rock streams, barely chipping away at incoming threats.
- Now: All PD weapons (Vulcans, Flak cannons, PD lasers) now deal 8.0x damage against asteroids on all fixed presets. PD now genuinely vaporizes incoming rocks on approach before they can breach your shields or armor. (Fully adjustable in Preset 0 "Custom").

• ☄️ Straight-Flying Megaliths & No More Strange Curves:
- Before: Giant boulders traveled along awkward curving arcs and could get pushed off course by tiny pebbles.
- Now: Orbital curve mechanics have been completely removed. Megaliths now fly in straight lines across the sector. 65% of them aim straight toward active ships in combat. Small rocks won't nudge them — but the moment ANY ship bumps into them or opens fire, the megalith instantly turns into a free physical object that you can push and use as mobile cover!

• 🌌 True Asteroid Belt Scale (8–16 Megaliths at Once):
- Before: Asteroid fields felt a bit empty with only 2–4 giant boulders drifting around.
- Now: Battles inside asteroid belts now smoothly spawn and maintain between 8 and 16 colossal megaliths simultaneously, making belts feel like actual dense planetary rings.

• 🧲 Shield Magnet Toggle Hotkey [T] / Mouse 5:
- Before: Your shield tractor beam was always active, sometimes dragging explosive fuel tanks into you or pulling salvage into friendly firing lines.
- Now: You can toggle the shield magnet ON or OFF mid-battle at any time with [T] or your forward side mouse button (Mouse 5). A clean, quiet floating text appears over your flagship: Magnit On or Magnit Off (silent, zero combat log or audio spam). Fully rebindable in LunaLib (F2).

• 🌊 More Frequent & Varied Formations:
- Geometric asteroid formations (wedges, fans, walls) trigger more frequently, can roll together with the main stream at the same time, and can mix different patterns simultaneously.

✨ Core Features of the Mod
• Living Asteroid Streams: Asteroid belts are no longer static rocks — combat turns them into roaring rivers of kinetic debris with realistic drift, speed, and ramming hazards.
• Guaranteed Derelict Recovery: Rare abandoned hulls drift through debris streams. Defend and stabilize them for 60 seconds, and they are guaranteed to join your fleet after battle with weapons intact and standard D-mods!
• Loot & Hazards: Domain survey probes, equipment caches, and cryopods drift through space (reel them in with shields). Volatile fuel canisters detonate with massive 1,200 HE blast waves when shot or rammed.
• Station & Deployment Domes: Orbital stations project deflector domes to part rock streams, while newly deployed ships get a 14-second protective deflector barrier.
• 5 Presets in LunaLib (F2): Switch on the fly from gentle Cinematic drift to 3,000 u/s Extreme Chaos.

⌨️ Controls & Hotkeys
• [T] (or Mouse 5) — Toggle Shield Magnet ON / OFF (Active in both campaign battles and simulator).
(Simulator-only hotkeys for testing):
• [/] — Toggle asteroid stream ON / OFF
• ['] — Spawn a test derelict ship
• [;] — Spawn a test Domain cache / explosive fuel tank
• [L] — Spawn a colossal megalith boulder
• [Shift + / -] — Adjust asteroid stream capacity
• [Ctrl + / -] — Adjust asteroid stream velocity

📜 Version History & Changelogs

v2.0.75 — Hotkeys & Reinforced PD Defense
• 8.0x PD Multiplier: Standardized 8.0x point defense damage against asteroids across all fixed presets.
• Straight Megaliths: Removed arc curving; megaliths fly straight (65% aimed at active ships).
• Vector Lock & Untethering: Small rocks cannot alter megalith course; ship contact or weapon fire untethers them into free physical bodies.
• 8–16 Megaliths Capacity: Asteroid belt battles maintain 8 to 16 simultaneous colossal megaliths.
• Shield Magnet Toggle [T]: In-combat hotkey toggle with floating "Magnit On" / "Magnit Off" indicators.
• Formations Buff: More frequent formations and multi-pattern stream combinations.

v2.0.70 — Direct Fleet Recovery & 14s Deflector Dome
• Direct Fleet Transfer: Stabilized derelict ships are directly transferred to player fleet after combat.
• 14-Second Deflector Dome: Extended deployment grace period with 98% kinetic collision reduction.
• Manual Controls Safety: Avoidance logic never overrides player controls during manual piloting.

v2.0.62 — Colossal Megaliths & Station Domes
• Added colossal megaliths with loot caches trapped inside their cores.
• Added station deflector domes that collapse on module flux overload.
• Fixed campaign detection in empty planetary ring gaps.

v2.0.6 — FixMagneto & Interactive Salvage
• Overhauled shield tractor beam with mass scaling and velocity damping.
• Added SOS derelict ships with 60s stabilization timers.
• Added volatile fuel tanks (1,200 HE blast waves).

v2.0.0 — Cyclone Edition (360° Formations)
• Added continuous background ring avalanche and multi-angle tactical formations.
• Added targeted snipe formations (5% chance).
• Optimized physics simulation to handle 200–300 rocks at smooth 120 FPS.

v1.0.0 — Initial Release
• Initial release: turned static vanilla asteroids into dynamic kinetic hazard streams.

Click above to check out the 1000x rock density stress test!

Click above to watch Dynamic Asteroids in action!

In full transparency: All Java code in this mod was machine-generated through iterative architectural prompting and dialogue with an AI assistant (Google Antigravity / Gemini). The human author acted as creative director, game designer, and QA tester: designing mechanics, diagnosing engine collision quirks, directing physics models, fine-tuning gameplay balance, and overseeing save compatibility.

releases.changelogNotes:
only googledrive 2.0.65 vers
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gEQWJM_GFgX6X_ozRUzgdiGJPdnN-53T?usp=sharing
I haven't figured out the official version for the new game yet, so I've uploaded the fix separately to Google Drive. As soon as I finish fixing the bugs, I'll upload a new patch to GitHub for both the new and old versions of the game.

• Colossal Megaliths: Introduced giant planetoid-scale boulders (diameters up to 1100u) with pushable Newtonian physics and curved gravitational slingshot orbits.
• Megalith Shatter Loot: Shattering giant megaliths drops high-tier Domain caches (20%), preserved fighter LPC chips (1.5%), or entombed derelict hulls (0.1%).
• Station Deflection Domes: Orbital stations project deflector fields that part asteroid streams. Module flux overload or destruction collapses the shield, leaving the station exposed.
• Deployment Grace Period: Added 7 seconds of collision damage immunity upon entering battle with deflector visual cues.
• Formation Wave Density Buff: "Expanding Fan" and "Dual Rails" formations reinforced with +20 to +40 asteroids per stream with tighter firing cadence.
• Campaign Map Detection Fix: Battles in empty ring gaps or non-hazardous fine dust rings no longer trigger asteroid hazards — only physical asteroid fields do.
• Fixed Left Border Flickering Line: Resolved engine reflection conflict with obfuscated classes, permanently clearing vanilla 1-pixel border asteroid generators.
• Repellor Boundary Sync: Asteroids and debris drifting past combat border repellors now cleanly despawn after 5 seconds.
